name: @limio/component-add-customer-details-to-order
description: A component to update customer details and custom fields on the order from query parameters. Automatically routes fields to customerDetails or customFields based on field name.

limioProps.label: Field Mappings: Maps URL query parameters to order fields. Standard customer fields (firstName, lastName, email, phone, companyName) go to customerDetails. All other fields go to customFields.

targetField.label: Target Field
targetField.description: Field name to update. Standard fields (firstName, lastName, email, phone, companyName) go to customerDetails. All others go to customFields.

queryParamName.label: Query Parameter Name
queryParamName.description: URL query parameter name to read the value from
